title: The Knot in the Soft Rope
youtube_title: The Knot in the Soft Rope | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Teamwork means each person holds a different part until the whole thing loosens.
summary: A soft boat rope cinches into a tight knot, and Bodhi, Auntie, and Grandpa each hold a loop until the loose end slips free in time for a tidy tie-up.
